metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. AI Debt Tracker WEEK 2. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B09 (verdict artifact), B10 (handoff) and B11 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The three source PNGs and their SVG sources are REFERENCE in pantry/, never slotted as media. The script's seven sections are split into eight body beats (1:13 splits into B03 the bugs and B04 calibrated-vs-measured) and the closing on-camera section becomes a limits beat; the split is logged in BUILD-LOG.md. FOUR THINGS NOT TO GET WRONG: the agent is NOT built, only its judge; 10 of 10 is a calibration and 2 of 3 is the measurement; 90.7% is flattering and hides a zero; and 30 of 32 is the searchable denominator, not 30 of 36.
